exclusions.origin: Armed Forces Retirement Home's Categorical Exclusions
exclusions.additionalContext: The following CATEXs require no documentation.
exclusions.exclusion: (a) Granting a lease (i.e., outlease), an easement, license, permit (i.e., licenses to Federal entities), or other arrangements for Federal or non-Federal use of AFRH controlled real property, where such use will remain substantially the same in scope and intensity.

exclusions.origin: Consumer Product Safety Commission's Categorical Exclusions
exclusions.exclusion: (1) Rules or safety standards to provide design or performance requirements for products, or revision, amendment, or revocation of such standards.
